reviewer_role: independent platform packaging review; reviewer did not implement the three fixes
scope: Tauri/Web/Android validation isolation, normal-host extraction, package completeness and protected-file exceptions. Core logic was outside this review.

findings.defect: Approved deletions were still rejected once removed from the Git index. Unstaged deletions remained in ls-files and hid the failure.
findings.fix: Allow an absent tracked path only when the explicit hotfix contract pins its after hash to null. Before/after hash checks remain active.
findings.verification: 4 fixture cases: seven approved deletions accepted; unapproved deletion/addition and a deleted file reappearing rejected.

findings.defect: Missing baked PNGs were omitted from enumeration and staging succeeded; an older staged copy could then be deleted.
findings.fix: Compare the actual image set with manifest entries, reject duplicate manifest names, and require approved original image/audio/extension sources. Existing hashes and destination-name collision checks remain active.
findings.verification: 11 fixture cases including complete package, missing/additional/duplicate/tampered images, missing original sources, missing HMEX and destination collision; sources unchanged in every case.

findings.defect: Checking only CMakeCache allowed copied or stale validation dist into the normal host. Initial fix still accepted normal HTML/JS combined with validation WASM.
findings.fix: Both prepare paths validate emitted HTML mode, preference namespace, persistent mount, JS validation exports, WASM header and compiled save-root before replacing the destination frontend.
findings.verification: 12 fixture cases using actual emitted artifacts; valid pairs accepted and cache disagreement, mixed JS/WASM, namespace/mount mismatch, missing exports and corrupt/missing WASM rejected.

suites.scope: Actual protected.check() with fixture filesystem and simulated Git metadata; no product Git index changed.

cases.case: approved seven deletions after git staging

suites.scope: Actual stage() against disposable source/destination fixtures; source hashes compared before and after every case.
Actual validate_web_artifact() against copied emitted normal/validation HTML, JS and WASM, with isolated mutations.

cases.case: cache OFF with validation into normal

original_behavior_review.normal_host: Compared previous main.rs with current normal.rs: existing storage/backup behavior retained; module imports, function entry point and validation-configuration guard changed.
original_behavior_review.normal_build_gates: Web and Android validation entry points remain guarded by HM_VALIDATION; normal build defaults disable validation.
original_behavior_review.storage_isolation: Validation Web uses /validation-persist and HeavyMach.Validation.; Tauri additionally uses a distinct app identifier and WebView store; Android uses a distinct applicationId.

fixture_history.note: Initial fixture expected a non-shipped authoring original to be optional. Revised expectation to rejection because the approved-source preservation contract requires that source too. Product code was not changed to accommodate the fixture; initial failed result retained.

document_review.scope: Original-source claims, standard PNG versus CgBI encoding, original-format MCH/MAP versus HMEX additions, and common consumption path.
document_review.finding: No unsupported original-source or encoding identity claim found. Requested that image comparison wording specify decoded/upload-input bytes rather than imply GPU framebuffer readback. Requested completion tense for the now-tested packaging fixes.

limitations: Fixture verification does not establish deployment or platform gameplay success.
Protected-file fixture simulates Git listings/show results; it does not stage or modify the product Git index.
Web artifact guard checks emitted markers and compiled save-root; it is not a cryptographic attestation of an entire build.
Only relative local evidence paths and hashes are published. Raw local result errors may contain disposable absolute fixture paths; those errors are omitted from this public summary.
